newsitem.title: TURKEY: Seven firms seek Turkish barley at $134.27-142.56.
newsitem.headline: Seven firms seek Turkish barley at $134.27-142.56.

text.p: Seven international companies presented bids on Tuesday for a Turkish Grain Board (TMO) selling tender for 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley for May and June shipments, a senior TMO official said.

Kayhan Unal, head of the TMO's foreign trarde department, told the tender meeting that Cargill, Finagrain, Louis Dreyfus, Lacosp, Alfred Toepfer, Glencore and Grains & Fourrages had submitted bids for the publicly-held tender.
He said prices for feed barley ranged between $134.27 and $142.56 per tonne. Only Alfred Toepfer bid for malting barley, at $143.62 per tonne.
The tender terms require the feed barley to be shipped from Mersin and the malting barley from Derince.
The following are per tonne prices and other details supplied by the companies -
--Cargill - 1. 50,000 T feed at $137.88. 2. 25,000 T feed at $137.66. Both shipments on May 12-23.
--Finagrain - 15,000 T feed at $134.27 with shipment on May 12-23.
--Louis Dreyfus - 1. 50,000 T feed at $140.65. 2. 50,000 T feed at $140.25. Both shipments on May 12-23.
--Alfred Toepfer - 1. 50,000 T feed at $142.12. 2. 50,000 T feed at $140.12. Both shipments on May 12-23. 3. 50,000 T malting at $143.62 with shipment on June 1-15.
--Glencore - 1. 50,000 T feed at $142.29. 2. 50,000 T feed at $141.19. Both shipments from either Mersin or Derince on May 12-23 and/or May 15-30 and/or June 1-20 at seller's option.

--Grains & Fourrages - 1. 30,000 T feed at $140.56 to be shipped at 10,000-tonne vessels on May 12-23 at buyer's option. 2. 30,000 T feed at $142.56 to be shipped on 5,000-tonne vessels on May 12-31 at buyer's option.
Officials said the tender result might be announced later in the day.
